## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you are running into. For example: "When I have 10+ playlists saved, there is no way to reorder them and I have to scroll through everything."

## Describe the feature

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Why does this fit the project?

Explain how this fits with the project's goals. gate-ae-prep is intentionally local-first, desktop-only, and has no backend. Features that require a server, database, or user accounts are outside scope.

## Alternatives you considered

Any other approaches or workarounds you have tried or thought about.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other tools that do something similar are welcome here.
